title: 第十九章 太极真功华山灭第二十章 内斗二恒
content_zh:
压下种种思绪。
师徒两个继续推演功法。
早在十天前，林凡就将诸多武学尽窥于心，加上老张的讲说，也参悟个七七八八，悟出了不少武道至理。
然后两人开始尝试创新。
以太极之理为根，以九阴、九阳为骨架，诸般功法为枝叶，吸取道经精髓，开始一点点的总结。
林凡只是打辅助。
老张为主，推演的同时，也不停的尝试。
以理论为基，以实践为本。
两人忘我尝试，将其它事情尽数抛于脑后。
林凡甚至连聊天群都很少进。
还有诸多私聊信息。
他只是捡几个加了好友，其余的都不理会。
林凡也时常感叹，这玩意，越来越像企鹅了。
时间缓缓流淌。
转眼又是两个月。
这天傍晚。
老张盘坐在一棵树下，周身道韵弥漫，真气流淌，引无数落叶汇聚周围，飞速旋转，逐渐形成了太极图形。
他头顶空气凝聚，引来天地之力，无形之风，凝聚成有形之图。
也分明是一个太极图。
阴眼散发着寒意，阳眼凝聚着燥热。

“成了！”
老张吐出两个字，周身气息猛然朝四周扩散，掀起狂风阵阵，将落叶远远吹走。
十米开外的林凡都被震得接连后退，直至撞在了一块岩石上。
“伤着了没？”老张察觉，身形一晃就到了近前，扶住他的手臂询问。
“师尊，没事。”林凡摇摇头，惊喜询问，“彻底成了？”
“彻底成了！”老张露出了笑容，“第一篇，先天之前，内练周天；第二篇，先天之境，引气入体，以内在太极为根，外显阴寒阳热为表；第三篇，宗师之道，悟天地道韵。第三篇入门，自然而然，踏入宗师之道。”
“师尊牛逼！”林凡挑起了大拇指。
老张的悟性是真的强。
又有百年武道经验积累，加上无双的悟性，还有他这个挂逼辅助推演，终于耗时两月，将功法推演完成。
实际上，这也是在老张原本开创的太极玄功的基础上进行改良，融九阴，练九阳，纳入易筋锻骨之意，吸取道经之妙，最终完善再完善，至如今终于功成。
“没有你，我即使能将太极玄功推演而出，也没有如今完善，更不会蕴藏着至阴至阳之妙。此功，以太极为根，阴阳为骨，可融诸法，演万术，包罗万象，穷尽演化，潜能无尽。以你我二人之力，还不能尽窥奇妙，不过却有无尽的容纳之理，可以一直演化下去。”老张捋了捋胡须，颇为自得，更为自豪。
林凡深以为然。
这两个月，他也耗尽了心力。
“师尊，那我就开始修行了！”林凡有了决断。
“可！”老张点头，“我为你护法。”
“好！”林凡早就等这一天了。
他从怀中取出一个瓷瓶，倒出了一粒丹药。
这是黄精丸，大补精气。
也是老张从西域金刚门获得的医术中，结合自身医理和武道底蕴，最终凝练出的丹方。
武当山很大，除了他们这些人之外，还有隐居的丹师。

老张亲自请来一位，开炉炼丹，这才有了大补精气的黄精丸。
content_en:
Suppress all thoughts.
The master and the apprentice continued to deduce the exercises.
As early as ten days ago, Lin Fan had a thorough understanding of many martial arts. With Lao Zhang's lectures, he also understood everything and understood many martial arts principles.
Then the two started experimenting with innovations.
Taking the principles of Tai Chi as the root, nine yin and nine yang as the skeleton, and various exercises as branches and leaves, we absorb the essence of Taoism and begin to summarize it bit by bit.
Lin Fan only played support.
Lao Zhang took the lead and kept trying while deducing.
Based on theory and practice.
The two of them tried selflessly and left all other things behind.
Lin Fan rarely even joins chat groups.
There are also many private chat messages.
He only picked a few and added them as friends, but ignored the rest.
Lin Fan also often lamented that this thing looked more and more like a penguin.
Time flows slowly.
In the blink of an eye, another two months have passed.
This evening.
Lao Zhang sat cross-legged under a tree, his whole body filled with Taoist charm, and his true energy flowing, causing countless fallen leaves to gather around him and rotate rapidly, gradually forming a Tai Chi pattern.
The air above his head condensed, attracting the power of heaven and earth, and the invisible wind condensed into a tangible picture.
It is also clearly a Tai Chi diagram.
The Yin eye exudes coldness, and the Yang eye condenses heat.
"It's done!"
Lao Zhang spat out two words, and the aura around him suddenly spread in all directions, setting off gusts of wind, blowing away the fallen leaves far away.
Lin Fan, who was ten meters away, was so shocked that he stepped back until he hit a rock.
"Are you hurt?" Lao Zhang noticed and came closer in a flash, holding his arm and asking.
"Master, it's okay." Lin Fan shook his head and asked in surprise, "Is it completely done?"
"It's completely done!" Lao Zhang showed a smile, "The first chapter is about practicing the Zhoutian internally before the innate state; the second chapter is about the innate state, introducing Qi into the body, using the inner Tai Chi root, and the external manifestation of yin, cold and yang heat; the third chapter is about the way of the master, understanding the rhythm of heaven and earth. The third chapter is about getting started, naturally stepping into the way of the master."
"Master is awesome!" Lin Fan raised his thumb.
Lao Zhang's understanding is really strong.
With a hundred years of martial arts experience accumulated, coupled with his unparalleled understanding, and his helpless derivation, it finally took two months to complete the deduction of the technique.
In fact, this is also an improvement based on the Tai Chi Xuan Gong originally created by Lao Zhang, integrating the nine yins, practicing the nine yangs, incorporating the meaning of changing the muscles and forging the bones, absorbing the wonders of Taoism, and finally perfecting and perfecting it, and now it is finally successful.
"Without you, even if I could deduce Tai Chi Xuan Gong, it would not be as perfect as it is now, and it would not contain the wonders of Yin and Yang. This skill, with Tai Chi as its root and Yin and Yang as bones, can integrate all laws, perform all kinds of techniques, encompass everything, evolve exhaustively, and have endless potential. With the power of you and me, we still can't see all the wonders, but there is endless accommodation and can continue to evolve." Lao Zhang stroked his beard, quite contented and even more proud.
Lin Fan was convinced.
In the past two months, he had also exhausted his energy.
"Master, then I will start practicing!" Lin Fan made a decision.
"Yes!" Lao Zhang nodded, "I will protect you."
"Okay!" Lin Fan has been waiting for this day for a long time.
He took out a porcelain bottle from his arms and poured out a pill.
This is Huang Jing Wan, which greatly replenishes vital energy.
It is also the elixir that Lao Zhang finally condensed from the medical skills he obtained from the Vajra Sect in the Western Regions, combined with his own medical theory and martial arts background.
Wudang Mountain is very big, and apart from people like them, there are also reclusive alchemists.
Lao Zhang personally invited someone to make an elixir, and then he had Huang Jing Wan, which can greatly replenish energy.
